title: Application Size and Delivery Analysis Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies application size and delivery analysis?
options: Measure delivered and installed bytes by device and attribute regressions before choosing shrinking or delivery changes.
Use AAB size as download size
Move all assets on demand without UX
questions.answer: Measure delivered and installed bytes by device and attribute regressions before choosing shrinking or delivery changes.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: An Android App Bundle’s filesystem size equals every user’s download size.
questions.explanation: Comparing raw AAB file size between releases can misrepresent what a device downloads because bundle compression and split contents differ.

questions.prompt: Which artifact should size investigation model?
questions.answer: The device-specific APK set and installed/first-use footprint, not only the source AAB.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
